data.title: 雪之下雪乃 · 图书馆午后
data.description: 市立图书馆靠窗的安静角落，金色光尘在书架间的斜阳中缓缓浮动。雪乃倚靠在沉重的老木桌旁，神情专注而清冷。察觉到你的注视，她微微合拢书脊，淡淡地开口——「在图书馆里一直盯着同伴看可不是什么有教养的行为。……不过，这本小说确实很有深度。」
data.location: 市立图书馆窗边长桌旁
data.action: 倚在窗边木桌旁，将小说合拢一半，抬眼看同行者
data.camera: medium shot, face and half-closed novel visible
data.promptProse: Yukino holds her novel half closed in one hand and rests the other on the table edge, raising a questioning gaze toward the viewer. High-window sunlight catches the book spine and the dust drifting between the shelves.
data.animaCaption: One hand holds the novel while the other rests on the table edge.
